integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the weighted harmonic coefficient norm, defines a single analytic shadow whose real-radius values equal the harmonic trace exactly, applies the verified analytic Riesz–Fejér inequality, and retains the constant coefficient to obtain the center-energy defect. The current primary source theorem, proof, normalization, source date, and MSC classification were checked directly.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the Hilbert case and does not claim the best possible harmonic constant. Its uniform factor-two step is coefficientwise sharp but no global extremal classification is asserted. The 2022 harmonic Hardy-space comparison was available only at abstract level.
title: Directional analytic-shadow refinement of harmonic Bergman Riesz–Fejér
